alts: Cage Spinner cage spinner with orange seat inside a lavender steel basket

data.description: On the Cage Spinner, a child sits on an orange seat inside a Lavender steel basket and spins around. The basket wraps around the seat, so the child can hold on from any side while turning. It is meant for the 3 to 6 years Key User Group and seats one child. Spinning helps young children develop balance and a sense of their body in motion, and many enjoy pushing themselves round. Its small size means it can sit near a toddler swing or spring rider in a compact play area. Galvanised pipe on this spinner is covered for 3 years and bearings for 1 year against manufacturing defects. Send us a photo of your play corner and we will suggest a spot for it.

items.pText: On the Cage Spinner, a child sits on an orange seat inside a Lavender steel basket and spins around. The basket wraps around the seat, so the child can hold on from any side while turning. It is meant for the 3 to 6 years Key User Group and seats one child. Spinning helps young children develop balance and a sense of their body in motion, and many enjoy pushing themselves round. Its small size means it can sit near a toddler swing or spring rider in a compact play area. Galvanised pipe on this spinner is covered for 3 years and bearings for 1 year against manufacturing defects. Send us a photo of your play corner and we will suggest a spot for it.

props.pText: The basket and post are galvanised steel finished in Lavender, and the seat is roto-moulded. We install it self-standing or grouted into the ground. Because a spinning child leans outward, keep other equipment well away from the basket, and inspect the bearing and basket welds during regular maintenance.
